answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the haven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the summit of the next round. The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
